pillars.note: No direct fire-safety pillar stated. The science objectives of the design review are lift-off and blow-out velocity limits of methane and ethylene flames, the hysteresis of lifting and reattachment, and the structure of the flame base. The cited review does not mention fire safety. Pillar list left empty on purpose; the reviewer should decide.
